text:
A scientist carries out an experiment using a sealed source which emits β-particles. The range of
the β-particles in the air is about 30cm.
Which precaution is the most effective to protect the scientist from the radiation?
A
handling the source with long tongs
B
keeping the temperature of the source low
C
opening all windows in the laboratory
D
washing his hands before leaving the laboratory

options.label: A
options.text: handling the source with long tongs

options.label: B
options.text: keeping the temperature of the source low

options.label: C
options.text: opening all windows in the laboratory

options.label: D
options.text: washing his hands before leaving the laboratory
